items.title: Red-Hot Power Stocks Are Losing Steam
items.summary: For some time, it seemed as though owners of existing power plants—such as  Vistra  and  Constellation Energy  —were in a great spot.  With demand growth outstripping new power supply, incumbent power plants could reap higher prices for their output without putting much capital at risk.  Power plant owners have had a rough year on the stock market.
